The Master Emerald pulsed in your hands, its green glow casting eerie shadows across the ancient ruins of Angel Island. You could still hear Knuckles’ voice in your head, stern as ever.

"This emerald is powerful. It keeps the island afloat. Do not—under any circumstances—let it fall into the wrong hands."

And yet, as you stood there in the moonlit temple, one of the wrong hands was already reaching for it.

A soft, sultry voice purred behind you.

“My, my… that’s a gorgeous gem you’ve got there, handsome.”

You turned sharply, gripping the emerald tighter.

Rouge the Bat.

Dressed in her signature black and pink bodysuit, her wings folded elegantly behind her, she leaned against a pillar with one hand on her hip. Her golden eyes gleamed with amusement, locked onto yours like a predator sizing up its prey.

She giggled, raising her hands in mock surrender. “Oh, relax. I just came to… talk.”

Rouge smirked, striding toward you slowly. “Steal is such an ugly word. I prefer… borrow.”

She was circling you now, her tail swaying behind her. Every step she took was deliberate, confident, like she was hunting.

“I mean, think about it,” she continued, her voice like honey. “You’re just standing here, all alone, watching over a gem that doesn’t even belong to you. Wouldn’t it be more fun to let someone… appreciate it?”

She was close now—too close.

Rouge pouted, tracing a gloved finger along your arm. “Thief? Ouch. You wound me.”

You swallowed hard. No doubt about it—she was trying to get into your head. And worse? It was almost working.
